corrections.text: The article states that "the configuration reference reviewed for this report does not describe them" (Unix Domain Socket targets). The configuration reference does describe them: "The __unix_socket__ label, when set, causes the scrape client to connect via the specified Unix domain socket path instead of the target's __address__. Set __scheme__ to http or https to specify the protocol used over the socket (defaults to http)." The release page itself gives no configuration syntax, as the article says.
